From the grill

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

Grill Chef in the old town

Grill Chef sits under the arches of the old town, two minutes from the Larnaca fort: a black and white chequered floor, wooden tables and the sign “Souvlaki, Gyros, Grill Meze” over the door. The menu says it plainly: fresh meat, freshly cooked by order, no deep frying. On Google, guests mention the souvlaki, the gyros and the octopus most often, and the choice runs from grilled seafood and Cyprus platters to vegan grilled vegetables.

Open every day from noon to ten in the evening, no closing day.
